lines.en: The wind arrives before I do.
My long coat blows slantwise.
I cross the puddle without looking.
Quick steps, very light landings.
I walk east along the sea wall.
Something at my waist rings faintly.
The wind opens the door for me.
I have walked this road many times.
I lift my head and taste the wind.
My hem flips up; I do not press it down.
I step around a corpse.
Something stirs beyond the sea.
I stand with wind circling my feet.
My hand rests on the clasp at my hip.
I listen beyond the wall.
My breathing is shallow and steady.
A judge should not look tired.
I look up at the sky in silence.
The surf sounds like whispering.
I shake the water from my sleeve.
No one thanks you for this work.
I wait for a direction.
I tilt my head; my gaze is cold.
You carry the smell of the sea.
I will not ask what you are.
Stand back; the wind carries scent.
Your hands had best stay still.
I look at you as if weighing you.
That attire is not from here.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没离开你的手
lines.en: My eyes never left your hands.
If you have no business, move on.
The wind makes you squint.

lines.zh: 我吸了一口气，把痛咽下去
lines.en: I drew a breath and swallowed the pain.
That was not light.
I press my sleeve to the wound.
My wind scatters; I recover at once.
Blood falls on the sea wall.
I clenched my jaw and let no sound escape.
My armor took one for me.
I reset my breathing.
Pain will not make me turn away.
I can still stand.
I do not eat what I have not checked.
On the ground, three steps back.
That will not buy me.
I am hungry, but not urgent.
The salt in the wind is more honest.
I won't take your rations.

lines.zh: 我不接受好意，也不记恨
lines.en: I take no favors, hold no grudges.
It cools in the wind; I do not care.
Salt water would do.
I glanced at it and kept my hand still.
I turn my shoulder and shed the force.
Hit me, and you will be the one moving.
The wind pushes me back into place.
Keep your hand off my shoulder.
We part and each goes on.
My hem sweeps your hand.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我的扣子响了
lines.en: That bump rattled my clasp.
Steady; do not block the way.
I raise a hand for you to step back.
The ground is wet; do not slip.

lines.zh: 这种事不在我的职责里
lines.en: That is not within my duties.
I swore to guard the sea wall only.
I do not keep companions.
The wind is no place for such words.
I pull my collar higher.
My back to you is the answer.
A judge should have no attachments.

lines.zh: 你若想留下，就守好自己的位置
lines.en: If you stay, hold your own post.
The wall is long; one is enough.
I will make no exception for you.
I pick it up and examine it.
This is no work of the sea.
I wrap it in cloth and stow it.

lines.zh: 掉在这儿，会被潮水冲走
lines.en: Left here, the tide would take it.
I wedge it into the door gap.
Some use; I keep it.
This is not mine to take.
I set it back on the stone.
I wipe my hand on my coat.
Its owner may still be looking.
The wind shifted. It is you.
I need not explain my reasons.
You have crossed the line.
Beneath my coat, my hand is ready.
This ground falls under my judgment.
I strike first, without greeting.
Your shadow falls on the sea wall.
Do not run; the wind tells me where.
I have your scent fixed.
I step, and the wind follows.
You will not get a second chance.
This ends today.
I count down for you, silently.
My weight settles forward, ready to spring.
No more questions. Begin.
Your breathing has betrayed you.
I follow the scent in the wind.
You go left; I am already there.
I round the pillar without slowing.
The farther you run, the louder the wind.
I wait for you to shut the door.
A wooden door will not stop me.
I push the door open and step in.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在水面上留下痕迹
lines.en: Your steps leave marks on wet stone.
I am patient; I plan further ahead.

lines.zh: 你每转一次弯，我都记着
lines.en: I note every turn you take.

lines.zh: 我在等你的武器先出来
lines.en: I wait for your weapon to show first.
There is no other exit here.
Sea wind pours into the alley, cold.
Pressing to the wall will not help.
I close two more steps.
You have even softened your breathing.
The wind carries your sounds to me.
I enter on three.
Your shadow grows shorter.
The wind has turned. My turn now.
A flick of my sleeve, and my hand arrives.
This strike is thin and fast.
I strike your wrist.
I slip aside and add a second blow.
I drag the wind with the blow.
Your guard is an inch too high.
I do not shout; shouting slows me.
A crossed step takes me inside.
That one was held back as a warning.
Three blows, no gap between.
My hem tangles your foot.

lines.zh: 我抬袖把你的反击带偏
lines.en: My sleeve swept your counter aside.
You retreat; I follow in.
That one passes your ear.
I drive the force into your shoulder.
Before the dust lands, I am set.
The wind is coming at you from behind.
The last one drives forward.
I recover and take half a step back.
Stand firm; this one lands harder.

lines.zh: 风先打了个旋，然后是我
lines.en: The wind spins first; then I appear.
I land before my coat settles.
The surf here is too loud.
First I scan the surroundings.
Another crack in the sea wall.
I set my hand at my hip.
A horn called me awake.
This is not a shore I know.
There is rust on the wind.

lines.zh: 我数了一下，只有一处脚印
lines.en: By my count, only one set of prints.
I raise my eyes and read the sky.

lines.zh: 领子立着，遮住了半张脸
lines.en: My collar stands, hiding half my face.
Flame bites my coat hem.
My ankle rolls on landing.
Seawater fills my throat.
The blast tears my coat open.

lines.zh: 箭从肋下过去，划开一道
lines.en: The arrow grazed under my ribs and opened a line.

lines.zh: 那力量穿过风，钻进骨里
lines.en: That force passes the wind into my bones.
Long hunger makes my hands light.
Lightning strikes through the damp air.
Even the wind stops here.
